titleText: Hundreds to gather for 11th edition of Caritas Christmas lunch at Curia
mainText: From Times of Malta: Hundreds to gather for 11th edition of Caritas Christmas lunch at Curia. People who cannot afford a festive meal or would otherwise spend Christmas alone are invited to attend

titleText: Government deficit nearly doubles to €695 million as spending outpaces revenue
mainText: From Times of Malta: Government deficit nearly doubles to €695 million as spending outpaces revenue. Higher income tax and VAT take-up fails to keep pace with a surge in spending, including on social benefits and energy support

titleText: Mental health and wellbeing at the heart of education, says Minister Byron Camilleri
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Mental health and wellbeing at the heart of education, says Minister Byron Camilleri. Education can only succeed if mental health and wellbeing are placed at the centre of everything done for both students and educators, Minister for Education and Sport Byron Camilleri said during the second edition of the national conference EduVoices. Held under the theme 'Your Voice.

titleText: KM Malta Airlines and Air India introduce single-ticket travel between Malta and India
mainText: From The Malta Independent: KM Malta Airlines and Air India introduce single-ticket travel between Malta and India. Travellers flying between Malta and India will be able to book their entire journey on a single ticket through Air India from 1 December 2026, following a new codeshare agreement with KM Malta Airlines.

titleText: Residents urged to unite as Mosta apartment block plans spark opposition
mainText: From MaltaToday: Residents urged to unite as Mosta apartment block plans spark opposition. In light of growing opposition to a proposed apartment block in Mosta, Il-Kollettiv called for the formation of a unified residents’ association bringing together residents from across the town to oppose similar developments.
